description: A drawing scope that puts three independently coloured shapes on one screen, each with its own position, scale, rotation and fill

params.text: Sets the colour of that shape's line, running once round the colour wheel from -10 to 10
Turns that shape, -10 to 10; with the button beneath it out, the setting is a rate and the shape spins
Switched in, that shape's rotation knob is read as a fixed angle; switched out it is read as a spin rate
Sets how much of the incoming signal one sweep of that shape covers, which stretches or squeezes it in time
Moves that shape across the screen, -30 to 30
Stretches that shape across the screen, -10 to 10
Moves that shape up and down the screen, -30 to 30
Stretches that shape up and down the screen, -10 to 10
Switched on, that shape's x and y scale knobs move together
Sets how solid that shape's line is drawn, 0 for invisible and 1 for solid
Switched on, that shape is drawn as a lissajous figure from its x and y inputs together; switched off the two inputs are drawn as separate traces against time
Sets how thick that shape's line is drawn, 1 to 10
Switched on, the inside of that shape is filled
Sets the colour of that shape's fill, running once round the colour wheel from -10 to 10
Sets how solid that shape's fill is drawn, 0 for invisible and 1 for solid
Picks how that shape is blended with what is already on the screen: SRC-OVR, DEST-OUT, LIGHT, XOR, SRC-ATOP, DEST-OVR, SRC-IN, SRC-OUT, DEST-IN, DEST-ATOP or COPY
Shows and hides the reading of every setting over the screen
Shows and hides the three knobs that set the screen's background colour
Sets the hue of the screen background, 0 to 360 degrees round the colour wheel
Sets how strong the screen background colour is, 0% to 100%
Sets how light the screen background is, 0% to 100%

inputs.text: Sets that shape's line colour, added to its colour knob
Turns that shape, added to its rotation knob
Sets how much of the signal one sweep of that shape covers, added to its time knob
The signal drawn across the screen for that shape
The signal drawn up and down the screen for that shape
Sets how solid that shape's line is drawn, added to its opacity knob
While this is high that shape is drawn, and while it is low the pen is lifted and nothing is drawn
Sets how thick that shape's line is drawn, added to its thickness knob
Sets that shape's fill colour, added to its fill colour knob
Sets how solid that shape's fill is drawn, added to its fill opacity knob

notes: the module has no outputs at all: everything it does is on its own screen
nothing is drawn until a signal reaches one of the x or y inputs
each of the three shapes has its own row of controls, and the three are drawn over one another on the same screen in the blend order set by each one's effect knob

inputs.18: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.19: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.20: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
